items.prompt: Why does sorting windows by start let the scan change only its last merged interval?

options.text: All earlier completed intervals end before the current frontier starts.
options.why: With nondecreasing starts, a new interval cannot reach back across the already separated frontier.

options.text: Sorting guarantees every interval has the same end.
options.why: Start order says nothing of equal ending times.

options.text: Earlier output intervals are removed whenever any overlap occurs.
options.why: The invariant preserves earlier disjoint coverage rather than discarding it.

options.text: The next interval must overlap some earlier output.
options.why: A new disjoint interval may instead be appended.
